about: Side writes to a built record, which the native kept core (TriviaStore::write_kept_in) and the TypeScript built arena (BuiltArena.writeSide) both keep: each case's writes, in order, then what its record holds. codes: the gap kinds its header keeps for a side. rows: a side's row, null for none. rowsRecord: whether its side word names a side record of rows. under: the side record it names under its rows, or that its side word names with no rows: own, the side record of other fields the record held before the writes, or none.

cases.name: three gap members go to the header, the rest to the row
a side the header holds whole keeps no row
a side replaced with nothing is written, its codes cleared
a write replaces the side's codes with its row
an inner side keeps no codes
a first written side is a side record of rows over the record's own
a record left with no row names the side record under its rows again
